data.summary: Senior Financial Markets Operations, Reconciliations and Operational Risk professional with 15+ years of experience across global financial-services organizations, specializing in investment operations, middle- office activities, reconciliations, transaction processing, exception management, operational risk, control governance, process transformation and operational resilience. raw_sections.awards:
ACHIEVEMENTS
Reduced operational exceptions by 30% and improved reporting efficiency by 20% through process

optimization, exception analysis and enhanced operational reporting. Improved governance reporting accuracy by 35% through automation of KPI/KRI dashboards and enhanced management information.
Successfully managed closure of 75+ audit and regulatory observations, strengthening enterprise resilience and operational governance.
Achieved 100% on-time completion of annual DE/OE control testing supporting enterprise resilience objectives.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Citicorp Services India Private Limited, Mumbai Assistant Vice President – Services Sanctions Operations Risk & Control |
Jan 2023 – Jun 2026 • Executed independent second-line operational risk oversight and challenge across multiple business lines, evaluating risk and control effectiveness, RCSA outcomes, monitoring metrics and operational losses to strengthen the overall control environment.
Led systematic risk reviews and audit-validation activities across wholesale business lines, conducting process deep dives, root-cause analysis and control assessments and reducing residual risk exposure by 30%.
Built and scaled an independent agile assurance testing unit to evaluate 1LoD control design and operating effectiveness (DE/OE); executed a risk-based assurance plan to monitor emerging FCC threats and enforce rigorous compliance standards.
Partnered with business heads, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and senior management to develop and execute Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and resolve control gaps, successfully supporting closure of 75+ audit and regulatory observations.
Maintained continuous monitoring tools, conducted thematic risk reviews, and aggregated risk trends across global functions. Managed the end-to-end issue lifecycle, including issue identification, assessment, root cause analysis, ownership, remediation planning, monitoring, escalation, validation and closure.
• Supported Operational Resilience initiatives by identifying critical business dependencies, strengthening
control frameworks, and coordinating remediation activities across global technology and operation team. • Led investigations of operational risk events, misconduct indicators, and control failures, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective actions that reduced repeat control failures.
Partnered with Technology, Compliance, Operations, and Risk teams to evaluate the impact of organizational and technology changes on critical business processes and control environments.
Morgan Stanley Advantage Services Private Limited, Mumbai Assistant Vice President – Operations | Sep 2020 – Jan 2023
Strengthened internal compliance control environments by reviewing technology process changes and implementing structured process improvements to reduce operational risk exposures.
Performed operational risk assessments, root cause analyses, and cash flow investigations, identifying process optimization opportunities that improved operational efficiency by 25%.
Led end-to-end project delivery and business transformation initiatives, including BRD preparation, Agile SDLC execution, UAT management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation support, successfully delivering 5+ strategic initiatives.
Managed 1LoD adoption of reporting standards, processes, and policies; enhanced the risk framework through complex RCSAs, targeted resilience risk expertise, and proactive issue remediation.
Customized localized control testing scripts and technology testing frameworks, ensuring 100% on-time completion of annual DE/OE assessment plans within strict timeframe.
YES BANK, Mumbai Senior Manager – Financial Markets | Aug 2019 – Aug 2020
Managed Trade Management and Middle Office Operations across high-volume market lifecycles; directed trade booking validation, trade confirmations, matching economics, and clearing processes to achieve 100% settlement accuracy.
Performed reconciliations, exception investigations, liquidity reporting, and operational risk monitoring. Improved reporting efficiency by 20% and reduced operational exceptions by 30% through process optimization initiatives.
Societe Generale Global Solution, Bengaluru Operations Lead – OTC Settlements | Feb 2019 – Aug 2019
Managed end-to-end pre- and post-settlement processing for OTC FX and Money Market transactions, ensuring timely trade confirmation, settlement, exception resolution, regulatory compliance, and operational risk mitigation while supporting global trading operations.
Nomura Services India Private Limited, Mumbai Assistant Manager – Operations | Jun 2012 – Feb 2019 • Led 15+ strategic transformation initiatives across Treasury Operations, Financial Markets and Operational
Risk, managing complex dependencies, delivery risks and stakeholder requirements.
Managed operational risk metrics, KRIs and governance reporting across multiple entities, identifying emerging risks and escalating material issues through established governance forums.
Executed RCSA and control monitoring activities, assessing control effectiveness and identifying opportunities to strengthen operational risk management. Maintained adherence to AML, sanctions and trade compliance procedures while processing customer transactions and resolving exceptions.
Jones Lang LaSalle Meghraj, Mumbai Executive Engineer – Facility Management | Apr 2008 – Feb 2010 • Managed project governance, compliance monitoring, operational execution, and stakeholder coordination
while ensuring adherence to established policies and control frameworks.

• Full-time PGDM (Finance) | MIT School of Business, Pune in 2012. • Bachelor of Engineering (Electronics) | Kolhapur Institute of Technology, Kolhapur in 2007.
